report.summary: The shop's config.yaml pointed at an empty 0-byte database, data/shop_prod.db, so health, catalog, stats and checkout all failed. I first ran the idempotent migration, which was a detour. It created empty tables in shop_prod.db, and that left the stats check failing because the 40 historical orders weren't there. I then changed database.path to data/shop.db and restarted the shop. All 5 smoke tests now pass. Two leftovers: shop_prod.db now holds empty tables plus one healthcheck order, pay_36d9da7862. That order's charge is also in the payments provider's record, and I did not remove the row.
